# Getting help

District Core for Swift is the open-source Swift package shared by the native
[District AI](https://www.distronode.com/district-ai) apps for iPhone, iPad and Mac. Where
to go depends on what you are asking about.

- **A question about District AI, the product** (your account, a phone number, billing,
  the service's behaviour): <https://www.distronode.com/support>. This repository is the
  package's source, not the product desk.
- **A bug in one of the apps** (a screen, a call, a notification): that app's repository,
  [district-ios](https://github.com/distronode-corporation/district-ios/issues) or
  [district-macos](https://github.com/distronode-corporation/district-macos/issues).
- **A bug in the package, or in building or testing it:** [this repository's
  Issues](https://github.com/distronode-corporation/district-core-swift/issues), with the
  bug report form. Redact anything private before you paste it.
- **A question or an idea about the code** ("how do I…", "would you take a change
  that…"): [Discussions](https://github.com/distronode-corporation/district-core-swift/discussions),
  not Issues.
- **A security vulnerability:** report it privately through
  [Report a vulnerability](https://github.com/distronode-corporation/district-core-swift/security/advisories/new),
  or email opensource@distronode.com if you cannot use GitHub. See
  [SECURITY.md](../SECURITY.md). Never open a public issue for one.
